BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, tsâʼâh is the word for issue, i.e. excrement. It appears 2 times in Scripture, including Deuteronomy 23:13 and Ezekiel 4:12.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that tsâʼâh is no accident in Scripture — God put it there on purpose.
